svg.title: EVE PI Planner — How It Works
svg.desc: A five-step vertical infographic in EVE Online capsuleer interface style explaining the PI Planner workflow: plan, estimate, deploy and rescan, fix issues, leave it and iterate.
svg.text: How it works — five-step workflow overview

text.tspan: Pick a product. Get extractor and factory
Numbers come from surveyed resource densities —
a solid starting point. Expect ± in the field.
Deploy your colonies. Then rescan to read your
Setup Analysis compares supply vs demand
and surfaces the lightest fix for anything off.
Stable steady-state. Re-check now and then as
resource densities deplete — small fixes only.
